home.demoSummary: From recurrence to evidence-based verification, then assistant follow-up
home.demoProblem: "Release checklist omissions" has appeared for the third time, with 0.89 similarity.
home.demoSource: Source: "We missed the database migration check again..."
demoHistory: Jun 30: First occurrence, no action created
Jul 14: Added PR template checks, verified
home.demoEvidence: Enforce migration checks in CI; owner Alex; workflow and failed-run links submitted for verification.
home.demoAskQ: Why does the release checklist omission keep recurring?
home.demoAskA: The last fix only updated the PR template; CI still lacks a migration gate, and the evidence is not verified yet.
